screen._note: Active display area of the 14in MacBook Pro (3024x1964 @ 254 ppi). Mirror-frame origin = lower-left corner.

camera_pose._note: Camera optical centre in Mirror frame (metres) and downward pitch. Laptop camera sits ~8 mm above the active area, centred.

depth._note: Weight of the Depth Anything metric estimate vs the BlazePose skeleton-scale estimate when fusing user distance.

gestures._note: swipe distances are in shoulder widths (sw) in the 2D image, so they don't depend on distance

perf._note: CPU/battery budget. depth only feeds the smoothed user distance, so a few Hz is enough.
